description: This file implements the ImportManager class and related functions for managing file imports, including caching, thread safety, and import loop detection in a build system context.

classes.name: ImportManager
classes.description: Manages file imports with caching, thread safety, and import loop detection.

classes.name: ImportManager::ImportInfo
classes.description: Holds information about a specific import, including its scope and load result, protected by a mutex.

methods.name: UncachedImport
methods.description: Loads a file and creates a scope for it, executing its parse tree, with error handling.

methods.name: ImportManager::DoImport
methods.description: Performs an import of a file, utilizing caching and thread synchronization, and merges the imported scope into the current scope.

methods.name: ImportManager::GetImportedFiles
methods.description: Returns a list of all files that have been imported.
